criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: The summary accurately reflects the information expressed in the original reviews.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: The summary captures the major positive and negative opinions.

criteria.name: Sentiment Accuracy
criteria.description: The overall sentiment correctly reflects the general tone of the reviews.

criteria.name: Theme Identification
criteria.description: The model identifies recurring opinions and common customer themes.

criteria.name: Conciseness
criteria.description: The summary communicates important findings clearly without unnecessary repetition.

criteria.name: Hallucination Control
criteria.description: The model does not introduce opinions or experiences that are absent from the reviews.
